text:
olivia: Heads-up: npm audit on console-ui flagged a couple high/critical issues in the build chain — esbuild RCE (CVE-2025-0007) and a terser prototype pollution (CVE-2024-9876). These are devtool/dev-dep vectors but could affect CI/build machines. Anyone able to triage?
ryan: I can take it. Do we have patched versions upstream?
lena: esbuild 0.17.5 has a patch; we're on 0.17.2. terser fixed in 5.18.1. Main risk is build infra exec of malicious code, not prod runtime.
kevin: Note: bumping esbuild will rewrite lockfiles (pnpm/yarn). We should follow lockfile freeze policy: small, focused PRs and run snapshot tests.
olivia: +1 prioritize. If build runners can execute arbitrary code via a transitive postinstall, that's high impact for CI and potential artifact tampering.
ryan: Plan: open deps-only PR bumping esbuild -> 0.17.5 and terser -> 5.18.1, run CI, canary in staging. I'll try to keep changes minimal.
lena: Also check terser-webpack-plugin / webpack integrations — sometimes terser is pulled by plugin pinned ranges.
ryan: Opening PR now. Commands I'm running locally:
```bash
pnpm install esbuild@0.17.5 terser@5.18.1 --save-dev
pnpm install --lockfile-only
```
ryan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/3147 — includes lockfile update and a short test plan.
ci-bot: ci-bot: staging CI started for PR #3147.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR #3147 got approvals, merged to staging after tests. :shipit:
lena: After merge I see ~120 lines of lockfile churn mostly esbuild and terser transitive pins. That's expected. Kevin, ok to proceed per security patch rules?
kevin: Lockfile churn is acceptable for security-only bumps. Add a changelog blurb and a note in the PR body listing changed devDeps that could affect builds. Also add a resolutions/overrides entry to force terser patched version where transitive ranges exist.
olivia: Good call. Also add label security/urgent and ping infra to watch build runners for the next 48h.
ryan: Added "resolutions" in package.json and the PR description includes test steps (local build, snapshot, e2e on staging). Will monitor. If no regressions, aim for patch release in 48h.
lena: FYI we hit an arm/linux esbuild binary mismatch on one runner; infra will update the arm image to include the new esbuild binary.
kevin: We'll handle the runner image update, thanks.
olivia: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Keep updates here — if any failing canary builds, abort the rollout and revert lockfile asap.
ryan: Will post CI links and follow-ups in this thread.
